notes.title: Mother Hub is LIVE
notes.notes: After 10 years of work, and constant support from all of you, Mother Hub is live. I will be the first to admit it's not perfect, but it is the best I could do with what I know in my journey. I promise you guys to always improve as I create, and I hope to do this full time one day.

notes.title: To my friends who don't speak English, I am sorry.
notes.notes: I am so sorry, I know I told you guys that I would be able to have Mother Hub translated to different languages. Unfortunately I have not been able to afford to translate it to any language, this is because I have recently lost my job due to trump tariffs in the USA so I have a lack of funds to make this possible for you guys. My next project I will do my absolute best to have it fully translated for you guys, but Mother Hub is only available in English. I want you guys to know I really care about you and appreciate your support.

notes.title: Release Date FAQ's
notes.notes:
[b]Release Date[/b]: April 23rd

[b]Key Bindings[/b]: I tried really hard for this guys but I would have had to reprogram the entire game. Unfortunately there are [b]no[/b] key bindings.

[b]Game Length[/b]: 2 hours of game play. Additionally a lot more if you listen to all the audio logs.

[b]Steam Deck[/b]: Yes.

[b]Wide Screen[/b]: Yes.

[b]Mouse Input[/b]: Raw.

[b]Inverted Options[/b]: Yes.

[b]Languages[/b]: Sadly though an over ambitious me thought I could get the game translated, there is so much dialogue in the game hours and hours, which would be so expensive for me to have translated. I am just a solo developer with no money and I couldn't afford to do it this time. I'm sorry guys it's only [b]English[/b].

notes.notes:
[h1][b]Progress list dump so you guys can see stuff is happening.[/b][/h1]

This month I did two things, recreated the menu, and recreated the journal. What this means is a rethought out the process and made it so much more clean and professional.

Turn off locomotion handler for jumping during menu with controller
Select button menu when opening it for controller
Detect if joystick button was used to open menu, - element select button (for navigation with controller)
open menu on controller button
Test controller with menu
Disable language select for now
Disable tutorial mode for now
Turn auto nav off for everything on controls besides look sens and invert
Keep mouse locked if opened with joystick
If returning to a previously seen tab it doesn’t reselect the button
If pressing b inside of settings tab it fully exits instead of returning to main menu tab
Check navigation on visual menu
Add UI L stick to show when on sliders (check if it works by just using it on button and not the slider)
Exit with b from panels to menu not reselecting default button
Controller settings set it explicit to only select each other (see if you can still scroll)
Visuals - when selecting the “title” button you can use R stick to cycle, make sure only titles are selectable, R stick works for window mode anti alias, textures, texture filter, shadow quality, need a way to select resolution when opened
There is an issue switching between tabs and the previous menu keeps the selected button, I believe this is because there is about a second delay between one tab opening and another closing this could result in not selecting the right button because technically two tabs are open and it gets confused. To further describe the issue, I open up a tab, which selects a button, then I go to the next tab and I can tell taht even though the previous tab is closed it’s selecting buttons on that closed tab still somehow, instead of moving to the next tab and selecting the button it’s suppose to.
Add load button with confirm

Connect brightness slider to detect camera - brightness, share the script first so it knows what to look for.

notes.title: Announcing a new game: Habilis
notes.notes:
[b]Habilis[/b] is a sinister-dark, 45 minute, first-person bodycam-style, Lovecraft horror game.


Follow Nathan Walters as he quickly descends into insanity. Discover the ancient secrets held within a futuristic abandoned factory. A bodycam, Lovecraft style horror experience not for the weak of heart. Hide, and survive if you can. 

[list]
[*]     Explore beautifully rendered science fiction style facility in the near future.
[*]     A handcrafted tale of one man’s descent into insanity and extreme sickness.
[*]     All dialogue voice acted by an all star cast of professionals.
[*]     Incredible, and unique music shaped to fit every scene
[*]     A short but sweet 45 minutes of non stop entertainment.
[*]     An adventure that isn’t for the weak of heart.
[/list]

notes.title: Zombie Rework
notes.notes:
I just want you guys to know that I hear you. Many of you were unhappy with the speed of zombies.
After some soul searching I decided to completely rework the zombie system. There are now various types of zombies.

[b]Zombie Rework:[/b]

Feral: Still quick and deadly. (very few now)

Walkers: Slow 

Screamers: The Screamers will alert near by zombies, they must be killed first. The screamers protect the pack, if one of the herd is damaged it will anger the Screamer. Screamers are larger, and have a red glowing implant.

Generally speaking there are more zombies in every level.

[b]Other changes:[/b]

Slightly reduced pipe swing speed
Pistol accuracy increased by 50%

FPS Limiter added to main menu

notes.title: Working on a complete Zombie over hall this week
notes.notes:
I want you guys to know that I hear you, when something is wrong I will fix it. A lot of you have expressed unhappiness with the zombies running at you full speed. I am changing this and working on it this week.

[b]New zombie Mechanics:[/b]
[b]Reduced speed (they walk now)
Wandering, they will patrol around at random even I don't know where they will be
reduced aggro range
Shooting them outside aggro range now aggros them
aggroing one zombie will pull others in the area
Head shots now cause zombies to stagger and stop for a second
body shots cause the zombie to flinch
new creepy breathing from 
and new creepy dialogue and SFX 
Zombies now have glowing eyes
Zombies now have a glowing implant in their chest (part of the lore) (you'll find out more in the medical section)[/b]
